recipes.name: Mac and Cheese Instant Ramen
ingredients: 1 cup (113g) American cheese, shredded or finely chopped
3 packages (390g) Shin Black Ramen (use 3 noodle disks, use 1-2 red and gold seasoning packets, discard the dried vegetable packet)
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

In a deep saucepot, melt the butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour, stir and cook constantly for about 1-2 minutes. Slowly pour in milk and heavy cream and whisk. Once smooth and lightly thickened and starting to simmer, cut off the heat and add cheddar, American and Gruyere. Mix until fully melted and incorporated, 2 - 4 minutes.
Cook ramen according to package directions for 3 - 4 minutes. Then drain.
Fold ramen into your cheese sauce until fully coated. Season with 1-2 ramen seasoning packets, serve immediately and enjoy.
